description:
These 8x8 terracotta tiles for bathroom wall are square, natural handmade terracotta pieces measuring 8 x 8 inches, made for bathroom walls and showers where you want a larger tile with fewer grout lines.

## How they look
Handmade terracotta tends to vary slightly in shade and edge from tile to tile, so a wall of them looks warm and hand-finished rather than printed. The natural finish keeps the earthy clay colour without a glaze. At 8 inches, these large square terracotta tiles cover a wall with fewer joints, so the clay itself carries the look.

## Where they work
- **Full-height bathroom walls**, where 8x8 clay tiles make cleaning simpler with fewer grout lines.
- **Shower walls** once sealed, with a contrasting grout to show the grid or a matching grout to blend it.
- **Rustic bathroom wall tiles** in a farmhouse or heritage-style home.

Unglazed clay is porous, so in a bathroom it works best once sealed; a good sealer generally keeps splashes and soap marks from soaking in, and the matte surface stays calm next to brass or black fittings.

## Good to know
- Size: 8 x 8 inches (as listed)
- Material: natural handmade terracotta
- Shape: square
- Category: bathroom wall terracotta tiles

Seal the tiles before grouting so grout does not stain the clay, then reseal as your fixer advises. Clean with a mild, pH-neutral cleaner; avoid acid cleaners.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colour range of the 8x8 terracotta tiles, then get a dated quote. Compare with the [12x12 inch terracotta tiles](/products/12x12-inch-terracotta-tiles) or browse the [terracotta bathroom range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-terracotta).

faqs.q: What is the price of 8x8 terracotta tiles for bathroom wall?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can natural terracotta be used on a bathroom wall?
faqs.a: Yes, once it is sealed. Unglazed clay is porous, so a penetrating sealer before grouting and an occasional reseal help keep water and soap from marking it.

faqs.q: 8x8 or 12x12 terracotta tiles for a bathroom wall?
faqs.a: 8x8 tiles are easier to handle and fit around fittings with smaller cuts; 12x12 tiles cover faster with even fewer grout lines but suit larger walls best.
